blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Anti-narcotics operatives arrested a 22-year-old woman in Cainta, Rizal during a buy-bust operation early Wednesday, netting over P1.7 million worth of shabu (crystal meth). The Rizal Police Provincial Office said members of the local police drug enforcement unit apprehended the suspect after she allegedly sold P1,000 worth of shabu to an undercover officer in Barangay San Juan at 12:55 a.m. The police seized seven plastic sachets containing suspected shabu weighing a total of 255.79 grams. Based on the Dangerous Drugs Board’s valuation of P6,800 per gram, the confiscated drugs were estimated at P1,739,372. READ: P1.3-M ‘shabu’ seized in Rizal […]...
